title: Medical Marijuana and Parkinson's Part 3 of 3
summary: A clip from the documentary Ride with Larry showing a retired police captain with Parkinson's trying medical marijuana for the first time. The change in tremor, dyskinesia and voice is shown unedited.
why: Shared as a vivid visual example of cannabis visibly reducing Parkinson's tremor.

quote.text: here is a video of a guy suffering from tremors due to Parkinson's disease. he is given medical cannabis and the results are highly visible.
